name: domsep-fluid-cannot-connect-to-mechanical-shaft
source:
COMPONENT FSrc(out)
  PARAM mdot, P, h0
  out.mdot = mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h0
END
FSrc        SRC(mdot=1, P=100000, h0=0)
MechGround  G()
connect(SRC.out, G.port)

error.message: connect(src.out, g.port): cannot connect a fluid port (src.out) to a mechanical port (g.port) — different physical domains. Couple domains through a transducer component (a motor, pump, heating resistor, …), not a direct connect.
